verses.original: τις ὑμῶν ἔχων πρᾶγμα πρὸς τὸν ἕτερον Τολμᾷ κρίνεσθαι ἐπὶ τῶν ἀδίκων καὶ οὐχὶ ἐπὶ τῶν ἁγίων
verses.transliteration: tis hymōn echōn pragma pros ton heteron Tolma krinesthai epi tōn adikōn kai ouchi epi tōn hagiōn
verses.literal: [If] any of you has a grievance against - another how dare he go to law before the unrighteous [instead of] . . . before the saints

verses.original: ἢ οὐκ οἴδατε ὅτι οἱ ἅγιοι κρινοῦσιν τὸν κόσμον καὶ εἰ ἐν ὑμῖν κρίνεται ὁ κόσμος ἐστε ἀνάξιοί ἐλαχίστων κριτηρίων
verses.transliteration: ē ouk oidate hoti hoi hagioi krinousin ton kosmon kai ei en hymin krinetai ho kosmos este anaxioi elachistōn kritēriōn
verses.literal: - vvv Do you not know that the saints will judge the world And if - you are to judge the world vvv are you not competent [ to judge ] trivial cases

verses.original: οὐκ οἴδατε ὅτι κρινοῦμεν ἀγγέλους μήτιγε βιωτικά
verses.transliteration: ouk oidate hoti krinoumen angelous mētige biōtika
verses.literal: vvv Do you not know that we will judge angels How much more the things of this life

verses.original: οὖν ἐὰν μὲν ἔχητε κριτήρια Βιωτικὰ καθίζετε τούτους τοὺς ἐξουθενημένους ἐν τῇ ἐκκλησίᾳ
verses.transliteration: oun ean men echēte kritēria Biōtika kathizete toutous tous exouthenēmenous en tē ekklēsia
verses.literal: So if - you need to settle everyday matters do you appoint [as judges] those - of no standing in the church

verses.original: λέγω ὑμῖν πρὸς ἐντροπὴν ἔνι οὕτως οὐκ οὐδεὶς ἐν ὑμῖν σοφὸς ὃς δυνήσεται διακρῖναι ἀνὰ μέσον αὐτοῦ τοῦ ἀδελφοῦ
verses.transliteration: legō hymin pros entropēn eni houtōs ouk oudeis en hymin sophos hos dynēsetai diakrinai ana meson autou tou adelphou
verses.literal: I say this to your vvv shame Is there really no one among you wise [enough] . . . . . . to arbitrate - between his - brothers

verses.original: ἀλλὰ ἀδελφὸς κρίνεται μετὰ ἀδελφοῦ καὶ τοῦτο ἐπὶ ἀπίστων
verses.transliteration: alla adelphos krinetai meta adelphou kai touto epi apistōn
verses.literal: Instead [one] brother goes to law against [another] and this in front of unbelievers

verses.original: οὖν μὲν ὅτι ἔχετε κρίματα μεθ’ ἑαυτῶν ἐστιν ὑμῖν ὅλως ἥττημα ἤδη διὰ τί οὐχὶ μᾶλλον ἀδικεῖσθε διὰ τί οὐχὶ μᾶλλον ἀποστερεῖσθε
verses.transliteration: oun men hoti echete krimata meth’ heautōn estin hymin holōs hēttēma Ēdē dia ti ouchi mallon adikeisthe dia ti ouchi mallon apostereisthe
verses.literal: - vvv The very fact that you have lawsuits among you means [that] you {are} thoroughly defeated already Why . . . not rather be wronged Why . . . not rather be cheated

verses.original: ἀλλὰ ὑμεῖς ἀποστερεῖτε καὶ ἀδικεῖτε καὶ τοῦτο ἀδελφούς
verses.transliteration: alla hymeis apostereite kai adikeite kai touto adelphous
verses.literal: Instead you yourselves cheat and do wrong even [against your own] brothers

verses.original: Ἢ οὐκ οἴδατε ὅτι ἄδικοι οὐ κληρονομήσουσιν βασιλείαν Θεοῦ μὴ πλανᾶσθε οὔτε πόρνοι οὔτε εἰδωλολάτραι οὔτε μοιχοὶ οὔτε μαλακοὶ οὔτε ἀρσενοκοῖται
verses.transliteration: Ē ouk oidate hoti adikoi ou klēronomēsousin basileian Theou mē planasthe oute pornoi oute eidōlolatrai oute moichoi oute malakoi oute arsenokoitai
verses.literal: vvv vvv Do you not know that [the] wicked vvv will not inherit [the] kingdom of God {Do} not be deceived Neither the sexually immoral nor idolaters nor adulterers nor men who submit to or perform homosexual acts

verses.original: οὔτε κλέπται οὔτε πλεονέκται οὐ μέθυσοι οὐ λοίδοροι οὐχ ἅρπαγες κληρονομήσουσιν βασιλείαν Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: oute kleptai oute pleonektai ou methysoi ou loidoroi ouch harpages klēronomēsousin basileian Theou
verses.literal: nor thieves nor the greedy nor drunkards nor verbal abusers nor swindlers will inherit [the] kingdom of God

verses.original: καὶ ταῦτά τινες ἦτε ἀλλὰ ἀπελούσασθε ἀλλὰ ἡγιάσθητε ἀλλὰ ἐδικαιώθητε ἐν τῷ ὀνόματι τοῦ Κυρίου Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ καὶ ἐν τῷ Πνεύματι τοῦ ἡμῶν Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: kai tauta tines ēte alla apelousasthe alla hēgiasthēte alla edikaiōthēte en tō onomati tou Kyriou Iēsou Christou kai en tō Pneumati tou hēmōn Theou
verses.literal: And that [is what] some [of] you were But you were washed - you were sanctified - you were justified in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ and by the Spirit of our God

verses.original: Πάντα ἔξεστιν μοι ἀλλ’ οὐ πάντα συμφέρει Πάντα ἔξεστιν μοι ἀλλ’ ἐγὼ οὐκ ἐξουσιασθήσομαι ὑπό τινος
verses.transliteration: Panta exestin moi all’ ou panta sympherei Panta exestin moi all’ egō ouk exousiasthēsomai hypo tinos
verses.literal: Everything is permissible for me but not everything is beneficial Everything is permissible for me but I vvv will not be mastered by anything

verses.original: Τὰ βρώματα τῇ κοιλίᾳ καὶ ἡ κοιλία τοῖς βρώμασιν δὲ ὁ Θεὸς καταργήσει ταύτην καὶ ταῦτα καὶ δὲ τὸ σῶμα οὐ τῇ πορνείᾳ ἀλλὰ τῷ Κυρίῳ καὶ ὁ Κύριος τῷ σώματι
verses.transliteration: Ta brōmata tē koilia kai hē koilia tois brōmasin de ho Theos katargēsei tautēn kai tauta kai de to sōma ou tē porneia alla tō Kyriō kai ho Kyrios tō sōmati
verses.literal: - Food for the stomach and the stomach - for food but - God will destroy them . . . . . . both - The body [is] not [intended] - for sexual immorality but for the Lord and the Lord for the body

verses.original: δὲ διὰ αὐτοῦ τῆς δυνάμεως ὁ Θεὸς καὶ ἤγειρεν τὸν Κύριον καὶ ἐξεγερεῖ ἡμᾶς
verses.transliteration: de dia autou tēs dynameōs ho Theos kai ēgeiren ton Kyrion kai exegerei hēmas
verses.literal: - By His - power - God - raised the Lord {from the dead} and He will raise us [also] . . .

verses.original: Οὐκ οἴδατε ὅτι ὑμῶν τὰ σώματα ἐστιν μέλη Χριστοῦ οὖν ἄρας τὰ μέλη τοῦ Χριστοῦ ποιήσω μέλη πόρνης μὴ γένοιτο
verses.transliteration: Ouk oidate hoti hymōn ta sōmata estin melē Christou oun aras ta melē tou Christou poiēsō melē pornēs mē genoito
verses.literal: vvv Do you not know that your - bodies are members of Christ vvv Shall I then take the members - of Christ and unite [them] . . . with a prostitute vvv Never

verses.original: ἢ οὐκ οἴδατε ὅτι ὁ κολλώμενος τῇ πόρνῃ ἐστιν ἓν σῶμά γάρ φησίν Οἱ δύο Ἔσονται εἰς μίαν σάρκα
verses.transliteration: ē ouk oidate hoti ho kollōmenos tē pornē estin hen sōma gar phēsin Hoi dyo Esontai eis mian sarka
verses.literal: Or vvv don’t you know that he who unites himself - with a prostitute is one [with her] in body For it is said The two will become . . . one flesh

verses.original: δὲ ὁ κολλώμενος τῷ Κυρίῳ ἐστιν ἓν πνεῦμά
verses.transliteration: de ho kollōmenos tō Kyriō estin hen pneuma
verses.literal: But he who unites himself with the Lord is one [with Him] [in] spirit

verses.original: Φεύγετε τὴν πορνείαν πᾶν ἁμάρτημα ὃ ἄνθρωπος ἐὰν ποιήσῃ ἐστιν ἐκτὸς τοῦ σώματός δὲ ὁ πορνεύων ἁμαρτάνει εἰς τὸ ἴδιον σῶμα
verses.transliteration: Pheugete tēn porneian pan hamartēma ho anthrōpos ean poiēsē estin ektos tou sōmatos de ho porneuōn hamartanei eis to idion sōma
verses.literal: Flee from - sexual immorality Every [other] sin - a man vvv can commit is outside [his] body but he who sins sexually sins against [his] own body

verses.original: ἢ οὐκ οἴδατε ὅτι ὑμῶν τὸ σῶμα ναὸς τοῦ Ἁγίου Πνεύματός ἐστιν ἐν ὑμῖν οὗ ἔχετε ἀπὸ Θεοῦ καὶ ἐστὲ οὐκ ἑαυτῶν
verses.transliteration: ē ouk oidate hoti hymōn to sōma naos tou Hagiou Pneumatos estin en hymin hou echete apo Theou kai este ouk heautōn
verses.literal: - vvv Do you not know that your - body [is] a temple of the Holy Spirit [who] is in you whom you have [received] from God - You are not your own

verses.original: γὰρ ἠγοράσθητε τιμῆς δὴ δοξάσατε τὸν Θεὸν ἐν ὑμῶν τῷ σώματι
verses.transliteration: gar ēgorasthēte timēs dē doxasate ton Theon en hymōn tō sōmati
verses.literal: - you were bought at a price Therefore glorify - God with your - body
